scope.summary: Developer guidance and PR template preventing incomplete Copilot PR evidence references.
implemented: Document canonical issue markers and paired evidence paths in agent instructions.
Provide a default PR template with explicit no-auto-close rule for incomplete work.

criteria.description: Repository contributor/Copilot instructions explicitly require `Refs #N`, `<!-- butterbox-issue: N -->` and `<!-- butterbox-evidence: docs/agent-work/issues/issue-N/pr-M/attempt-XX.evidence.json -->` in each PR description, with matching JSON and Markdown files.

evidence.outcome: Instructions present for canonical references and evidence markers; automated CI still pending.
